# Baseline Work
> Pre-deal scope checks and price floor calculation for video creators and creative freelancers.

## About Baseline
Baseline Work stops creative freelancers (specifically short-form video editors, motion designers, and creative directors) from underquoting, absorbing scope creep, and accepting unpriced client assumptions. When you paste an incoming client brief, Baseline maps missing parameters, calculates a mathematical price floor from real operating overhead, and formats 3-option deal proposals and lightweight pre-deal scope agreements.

## Core Capabilities
- **Brief Analysis & Hidden Scope Detection**: Parses unstructured client text to flag unpriced variables (aspect ratios, raw footage organization, turnaround speed, revision limits, subtitles, motion complexity).
- **Price Floor Calculator**: Computes minimum hourly rate from monthly take-home pay, business overhead, emergency reserves, and billable utilization ratios.
- **3-Option Deal Proposals**: Structures options (Budget-fit / Core / Safety-first) to prevent all-or-nothing pricing traps.
- **Pre-Deal Scope Agreements**: Generates lightweight, mobile-friendly deal sign-off sheets (`/s/:token`) for WhatsApp or email before creative work begins.
- **Judge Mode Simulation**: A 90-second interactive workflow showing how unpriced scope turns profitable proposals into losses.

## Target Audience
- Short-form video editors (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts)
- Motion designers and commercial video creators
- Independent digital creative freelancers
